title: Surreal TV Painting
description: A vibrant surreal painting framed within an old television set, featuring a crowded composition with duplicated women in blue spiral-patterned dresses, men in colorful suits on green pathways, large symbolic letters A B C, floating eyes, blue dragons, red dripping liquid, and a prominent green spiral creature with a smiling orange mouth and numbered circles.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal psychedelic painting displayed inside an old CRT television frame. The scene shows rows of identical women wearing blue dresses covered in orange and white spiral patterns, standing in the foreground. Two men in colorful patterned suits stand on bright green pathways. Floating above are large dripping red liquid shapes, the letters A B C, multiple stylized eyes, blue dragons, and a large green spiral-faced creature with a wide orange smile and numbered circles. The background is bright blue with concentric circles. Vibrant, crowded symbolic composition with heavy repetition.
